{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Sports Drink''' was a fast enemy part of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had slightly slower speed than the [[Soccer Head]] but it had higher health than all the enemies that appeared before it. Additionally, it could also spawn with [[Bloated]], [[Aggro]] or [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Sports Drink''' is a red and black bottle featuring the Adidas logo. This bottle has arms wearing white gloves and legs with shoes on them. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **Towers like the [[Trapper]]'s bear traps can be used to stall it. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} SportsDrinkCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SportsDrinkIconIG.png|'''Sports Drink''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Sports Drink''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Sports Drink''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Sports Drink's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Sports Drink''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|[[Soccer Head]]|Wave 6|Sports Drink|Wave 7|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 8}} {{CompetitionCourt|[[Soccer Head]]|Wave 7|Sports Drink|Wave 8|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 9}} {{VictoryField|[[Soccer Head]]|Wave 7|Sports Drink|Wave 8|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 9}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
